title: Per-Employee Monthly Fee Schedule for the PBM Services Agreement
content:
Under the PBM Services Agreement, Northbridge Rx charges two fees that are set per enrolled employee (subscriber) per month and stated in USD: the administrative fee, and the clinical program fee covering clinical programs such as utilization management and specialty care management. The amount of each fee depends on the sponsor's pricing arrangement.

| Pricing arrangement | Administrative fee (USD per employee per month) | Clinical program fee (USD per employee per month) |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 3.25 | 0.35 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 4.50 | 0.35 |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 2.75 | 0.50 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 2.10 | 0.00 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 1.85 | 0.25 |

## Points of reading

**Who counts as an employee for these fees.** The unit is the enrolled employee, meaning the subscriber, not each covered family member; both fees are expressed per enrolled employee per month.

**What the clinical program fee pays for.** It is the fee for clinical programs, which include utilization management and specialty care management.

**Arrangements with a zero fee.** Northbridge Traditional Pricing carries 0.00 for both fees. Northbridge Enterprise Value carries an administrative fee of 2.10 and a clinical program fee of 0.00.

**Highest and lowest figures.** Among the six arrangements the administrative fee ranges from 0.00 (Northbridge Traditional Pricing) to 4.50 (Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus); the clinical program fee ranges from 0.00 to 0.50 (Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus).
